summary: STILL HERE is an interactive 3D web documentary giving first-person voices, spacecraft POV optics, and NASA archival imagery to five enduring missions—Apollo 11 Eagle, Apollo 17 LRV-3, Opportunity, InSight, and Voyager 1.
details:
STILL HERE transforms dormant lunar, Martian, and interstellar spacecraft into an interactive, first-person 3D web documentary across 56 story beats and 5 mission chapters:

1. Apollo 11 LM-5 Eagle (Moon — Mare Tranquillitatis, 1969-059C)

2. Apollo 17 LRV-3 Lunar Rover (Moon — Taurus-Littrow Valley, 1972-096C)

3. MER-B Opportunity Rover (Mars — Perseverance Valley, 2003-032A)

4. InSight Mars Lander (Mars — Elysium Planitia, 2018-042A)

5. Voyager 1 Interstellar Probe (Ophiuchus — 166+ AU / Interstellar Medium, 1977-084A)

Plus an interactive Solar System Orrery comparing all five locations beyond the heliopause.

What It Does & Key Features:

- Distinct First-Person Voice Narration: Each spacecraft speaks in a unique, emotionally expressive voice via ElevenLabs neural Text-to-Speech (with Edge Neural and Web Speech fallbacks) and synchronized word highlighting, with background audio auto-ducking.

- High-Detail 3D Engineering Rigs & Subsystem Inspection: Built in Three.js with NASA GLB reference models, PBR Kapton gold thermal foil, beta cloth, and terrain shaders. Users can enter "Inspect 3D" to orbit freely, toggle Explode Parts and X-Ray views, and click 25 annotated engineering hotspots.

- Spacecraft POV Optical Modes: Switch cameras directly into Eagle's 1969 Westinghouse slow-scan monochrome TV, LRV-3's color GCTV camera, Opportunity's stereo Pancam (with live True Color, 753nm IR Sulfate, and 432nm Violet Hematite spectral shaders), InSight's dust-hazed IDC fisheye, and Voyager 1's Pale Blue Dot narrow-angle vidicon.

- Interactive Space Physics Actions: Trigger a 532nm lunar laser retroreflector ping, replay LM-5 stage separation, kick up lunar dust behind LRV-3's map-taped fender, replay Mission Control's 1.3-second liftoff camera pan, grind hematite outcrops with Opportunity's RAT tool, trigger InSight's Sol 1222a M5.0 marsquake & solar-panel cleaning sand, and animate Voyager 1's Golden Record soundwave hologram and 160 bps radio carrier.

- Procedural Web Audio Telemetry & Soundscapes: Real-time Web Audio synthesizer generating authentic NASA 2525 Hz / 2475 Hz Quindar tones, lunar/Martian/interstellar ambient soundscapes, and beat-specific mechanical sound effects.

- Live NASA Open Data Integration: Fetches "Then vs. Now" archival mission photos and orbital reconnaissance imagery on demand via the NASA Image and Video Library API (images-api.nasa.gov) with SVG reconnaissance plate fallbacks.

Why It Matters & How It Addresses the Challenge:

Students, museum visitors, and the public often only encounter historic missions as isolated numbers or dusty museum plaques. STILL HERE connects real mission coordinates, hardware durability lessons (dust mitigation, autonomous fault recovery, optical keeping-out zones), and live NASA archives to humanity's upcoming Artemis return to the Moon and human Mars missions.

Tools, Languages & Tech Stack:

React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Three.js (GLTFLoader, DRACOLoader, MeshoptDecoder, custom GLSL post-processing shaders), GSAP, Web Audio API, ElevenLabs TTS API, Lucide Icons, and Vercel.
